summary: Iteration 4 — validated Global-Scale/Market-Ready features. All existing iteration_3 tests (10/10) and iteration_2 tests still pass. FRONTEND (Expo web, 390x844): Login via 'Use Demo Account' (login-demo) as Kauri works; Radar shows mode-selector chips row with mode-social + mode-networking + mode-campus + mode-events testIDs; tapping mode-networking navigates to /networking screen (title 'Intro Networking' visible), back returns to Radar with 'Networking' chip visually active (verified state persisted on backend). Filling name/email + toggling waitlist-ambassador-switch + tapping waitlist-submit shows waitlist-success 'You're on the list!' state. Cities city-Melbourne row opens Melbourne landing with 'INTRO MELBOURNE' + city-make-mine button. Ambassador Hub (/ambassador) shows stats grid (42 invites, 28 signups, 19 active users, 8 accepts, 4 conversations, 2 events hosted), 5 tasks toggleable via ambassador-task-* testIDs, Invite People button navigates to /invite. /launch-checklist shows launch-checklist-screen with 13 items; tapping first checklist-item-* updates checklist-progress from '0 of 13 complete' to '1 of 13 complete'. /demo-accounts: filter-count starts '22 of 22', tapping filter-city-Melbourne reduces to '10 of 22' and hides Amelia (London); filter-verified checkbox further reduces to '6 of 22'; global demo-account-amelia visible when city=All. New registration flow: /register (with register-name/email/age/password + register-18-checkbox) navigates to /intent — intent-screen renders 'What brings you to Intro?' with 6 options (intent-meet-new-people, intent-professional-networking, intent-dating, intent-campus-life, intent-events-meetups, intent-just-curious) + intent-skip; tapping intent-dating persists intent via PUT /users/me/state and navigates to /profile-setup. Two frontend issues found — see below.

ui_bugs.issue: When navigating directly to /metrics or /trial-report via URL (page.goto — e.g. bookmark, deep link, or web refresh), the screens render with all numbers as em-dashes ('—') or stay stuck on a loading spinner forever. Backend logs show 401 responses because the fetch fires BEFORE the async token restoration in AuthContext completes. Root cause: /app/frontend/src/lib/session.ts holds token in an in-memory module variable that resets on full page reload; AuthContext restores it via useEffect + AsyncStorage.getItem (async), but useFocusEffect in metrics.tsx:47 and trial-report.tsx dispatches the API call before setSessionToken runs. Repro: navigate to https://.../metrics after login → north-star-total shows '—Total' and metric-demo_signups shows '—Total demo signups'; navigate to https://.../trial-report → screen stuck on spinner. Works fine when navigating via profile menu inside the app. Reference: /app/frontend/src/lib/session.ts:1, /app/frontend/src/context/AuthContext.tsx:73-74, /app/frontend/app/metrics.tsx:42-47, /app/frontend/app/trial-report.tsx.

Carry-over from iteration_2/3: the incoming-ping modal ('Someone nearby wants to network' with View Profile / Dismiss) is rendered as a bottom-sheet overlay that covers the Profile tab's menu rows (particularly menu-metrics, menu-trial-report, menu-launch-checklist that are lower on the scroll) even after tab-change. On the Profile screen this overlay intercepts taps on the bottom-half menu items, silently blocking navigation to /metrics and /trial-report from the menu (URL stayed at /profile). Recommend auto-dismissing the ping modal on tab-change / route-push.

issues: North-star numbers should show 0 (int) not em-dash when API returns 0; because the frontend uses `northStar[key] ?? '—'`, valid 0 values render as '0' correctly — the em-dash only appears on 401/failed fetch. Consider a visible error state instead of silent em-dashes so users know data failed to load.
The 18+ confirmation checkbox testID is 'register-18-checkbox' (not documented in review) — worked fine once ticked.

react_native_issues.issue: Expo Web console still emits repeated deprecation warnings from iteration_3: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' seen on radar mount. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme.ts (shadow.card etc.)

action_items: FRONTEND (Medium): Fix the token-race on direct URL access to authed screens (/metrics, /trial-report, others). Options: (a) synchronously read token from localStorage in session.ts on module init on web, (b) gate the metrics/trial-report fetches behind `token` from useAuth() so they only fire after restore, or (c) inject token into api() from AuthContext instead of module-level cache. Reference: /app/frontend/src/lib/session.ts:1, /app/frontend/src/context/AuthContext.tsx:64-80, /app/frontend/app/metrics.tsx:42-47, /app/frontend/app/trial-report.tsx.

FRONTEND (Medium, carry-over from iter_2/3): Auto-dismiss the incoming Ping modal on tab change / route.push so it doesn't cover menu-metrics/trial-report/launch-checklist on the Profile screen and best-view-profile on Radar. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx + wherever the ping modal is portaled.
FRONTEND (Low, carry-over): Replace deprecated shadow* style props with boxShadow to silence Expo Web console warnings.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 945 lines — over the 700-line guideline. Suggest splitting global features (cities/zones/ambassador/campus/communities/waitlist/trial-report/north-star) into a routes/global.py module. Non-blocking.
public_user helper correctly adds mode, intent, city, country, ambassador fields (server.py:159-164). PUT /users/me/state accepts all three (server.py:84-87).
/api/waitlist is public (no auth) — correct for waitlist signups from marketing/landing.
/api/events/demo, /api/trial-report, /api/north-star, /api/metrics all correctly require auth via Depends(get_current_user).
/api/metrics.signups_by_city aggregates users by user.city (Melbourne always present via seed). Efficient enough at demo scale; consider a $group aggregation if user counts grow.
AMBASSADOR_DEMO, DEMO_EVENT, DEMO_CAMPUS, CITIES, ZONES, COMMUNITIES, MODES, GLOBAL_DEMO_USERS are all hardcoded dicts — acceptable for MVP demo; document that these are static seeds.
GLOBAL_DEMO_USERS seed sets demo_dist ≤ 100 for every entry — respects the strict 100m radius rule. Verified.
compute_nearby correctly filters by user.city (server.py:386) so global demo users only appear to users in their own city — worldwide app, local radar rule enforced.

Frontend: session.ts holds token in-memory only. This is fine for React Native (where the app is a long-lived native process) but breaks on web full-page reload before AuthContext rehydrates. Consider adding a synchronous localStorage read in session.ts on Platform.OS === 'web'.
Deprecated Expo packages: NONE found (no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch).

rca_of_issue: 1) Metrics/trial-report empty on direct URL: session.ts holds token in a module-scope let variable (in-memory). On web page.goto/refresh, this resets to null. AuthContext restores from AsyncStorage(localStorage) via useEffect which is async; useFocusEffect in metrics.tsx and trial-report.tsx fires the fetch before the token is restored, causing 401. Fix: on Platform.OS==='web', synchronously seed token from localStorage.getItem('auth_token') at session.ts module init, OR pass token from useAuth() into api() calls in these screens. 2) Ping modal covers Profile menu items: iteration_2 introduced ping modal as a bottom overlay that stays mounted across tab changes. Fix: dismiss on route change (useEffect on pathname), or lift it above the tab bar with pointerEvents='box-none' so only its own children are tappable.
